description: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, US Representative French Hill (R-AR) and US Representative Glenn Ivey (D-MD) discuss the Department of Justice's decision to drop the criminal investigation into the Federal Reserve's building costs. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran Says No Meeting Planned With US | Balance of Power: Late Edition 04/24/2026

author: Erik Larson
description: A judge questioned whether President Donald Trump’s $10 billion privacy lawsuit against the Internal Revenue Service and the US Treasury can proceed in court with Trump effectively in control of both sides of the litigation.
title: Trump’s $10 Billion IRS Leak Suit Called Into Question by Judge

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss ongoing market reaction to potential US-Iran talks, and the DOJ's partial reversal of a criminal probe into the Federal Reserve. Bloomberg News International Economics & Policy Correspondent Mike McKee joins to discuss. Then, Grindr CEO George Arison discusses the company's inaugural White House Correspondents' Dinner party and its ongoing political initiatives. Plus, Bloomberg Businessweek National Correspondent Josh Green joins to discuss his piece on Kentucky Representative Thomas Massie. Finally, 'Bloomberg This Weekend' host David Gura joins to discuss the latest on Iran talks.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Stocks At All-Time Highs, Powell Probe Reversal | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 4/24/2026

author: Annie Massa
description: A longtime adviser to President Donald Trump and a fundraiser involved in soliciting donations for his White House ballroom were named to the board of his social media company.
title: Trump Adviser, Fundraiser Snag Board Seats at Truth Social Firm

author: Jenny Leonard, Yian Lee, Miaojung Lin
description: A senior Taiwanese official expressed concern that President Donald Trump might make concessions on the self-governed island in his meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and said that Taiwan was working hard to prevent such a scenario.
title: Taiwan Fears It’ll Be ‘On the Menu’ at Xi’s Summit With Trump

description: Rep. Glenn Ivey (D-MD) shares his reaction to the Department of Justice’s decision to drop their investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell. He sees the news as a victory, but criticizes President Trump's use of power by calling the investigation “frivolous,” and suggesting it shouldn’t have started in the first place. Rep. Ivey also talks about speaking with Commerce Secretary Lutnick on tariff refunds and next steps. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: A Frivolous Investigation: Rep. Ivey on DOJ Drops Powell Probe

author: Jonnelle Marte, Catarina Saraiva
description: A decision by US District Attorney Jeanine Pirro to drop a criminal probe into the Federal Reserve potentially clears a path for President Donald Trump’s nominee to take over the central bank. What it won’t do is secure the current Fed chair’s departure.
title: DOJ’s Partial Reversal on Powell Probe Keeps Fed Drama Alive

author: Allyson Versprille
description: The Trump administration is weighing whether to invoke the Defense Production Act to support a potential bailout of Spirit Aviation Holdings Inc. according to a person familiar with the matter who requested anonymity because the talks are private.
title: US Considers Using Defense Production Act for Spirit Bailout

author: Jorgelina Do Rosario, Fabiola Zerpa, Andreina Itriago
description: Venezuela and US officials are in talks to incorporate political opposition and independent members to the board of the South American country’s central bank, a key potential step toward power-sharing to help root out corruption.
title: Venezuela, US in Talks to Bring Opposition Onto Central Bank Board

author: Zoe Tillman
description: State officials, the Democratic Party and voting rights groups are racing against the calender to try to halt President Donald Trump’s latest effort to restrict voting by mail ahead of the midterm elections in November.
title: Trump Opponents Push to Block Mail Voting Curbs Before Midterms

description:
Rep. Seth Magaziner (R) Rhode Island said Anthropic is doing the right think by warning the world about what they discovered about Mythos and working with the Pentagon, but that Congress needs to develop a federal framework for AI.
A small group of unauthorized users have accessed Anthropic PBC’s new Mythos AI model, a technology that the company says is so powerful it can enable dangerous cyberattacks, according to a person familiar with the matter and documentation viewed by Bloomberg News.
A handful of users in a private online forum gained access to Mythos on the same day that Anthropic first announced a plan to release the model to a limited number of companies for testing purposes, said the person, who asked not to be named for fear of reprisal. The group has been using Mythos regularly since then, though not for cybersecurity purposes, said the person. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Balance of Power 4/24/2026

author: Nathan R Dean
description: The end of the DOJ investigation may not be the end of the story.
title: Looking at What’s Next for the Fed With the Powell Probe Dropped

author: Magdalena Del Valle
description: The US sanctioned a Chinese oil refinery as well as dozens of shipping firms and vessels that transport Iranian oil, as the Trump administration ramps up economic pressure on Tehran ahead of diplomatic talks.
title: US Sanctions China Refinery, Iran Shadow Fleet Ahead of Talks

author: Greg Ryan
description: Maine Governor Janet Mills vetoed what would have been the first statewide freeze on large data center development, saying it would hurt a part of Maine in need of an economic boost.
title: Maine Governor Mills Vetoes Statewide Data Center Moratorium

author: Laura Nahmias
description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani insisted his push for a new tax on pricey second homes isn’t “motivated by any one individual,” as reporters pressed him on whether he regretted singling out billionaire Ken Griffin’s $238 million Manhattan penthouse in a viral social-media video.
title: NYC’s Mamdani Tries Defusing Griffin Blowback to Second-Home Tax

author: Dayanne Sousa, Ana Mano
description: Brazil is taking action to increase the use of ethanol in gasoline in an effort to tame the impacts of rising fuel costs as the war in the Middle East drags on.
title: Brazil Setting Higher Ethanol Blend to Stem Fuel Impact From War

author: Thomas Seal
description: British Columbia Premier David Eby’s government is finalizing a new royalty regime on gas extraction that has caused jitters in the energy industry, with major new liquefied natural gas investments hanging in the balance.
title: British Columbia Sparks Angst Over Gas Tax Change Amid LNG Race

author: Will Kubzansky, Lucia Kassai
description: An unusual series of cargoes of military-grade fuel that is due to sail from the US across the Pacific Ocean illustrates how far the war in Iran has disrupted the global oil supply chain.
title: Military-Grade Jet Fuel Cargoes From US Show Scale of War Impact

author: Jimmy Jenkins
description: The US Justice Department on Friday released a sweeping report calling for a significant expansion of the federal death penalty, including policy recommendations for faster executions, widening the use of capital punishment, and adopting additional execution methods.
title: Justice Department Calls for Expansion of Federal Death Penalty

description:
President Donald Trump will send two envoys to Pakistan with the intention of talking with Iranian officials, while Tehran sounded a more pessimistic tone on the prospects of further negotiations. 
Special envoy Steve Witkoff and the president’s son-in-law Jared Kushner are set to participate in talks this weekend, White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt said in a Fox News interview on Friday.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is also set to be in Pakistan but hasn’t publicly agreed to sit down with Trump’s representatives. No talks are slated to take place between US and Iranian officials during the foreign minister’s trip, semi-official Tasnim news agency reported earlier. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: White House Sends Team to Pakistan as Iran Balks at Talks

author: Beatriz Reis, Martha Viotti Beck
description: Brazil moved to ban prediction markets tied to elections and sporting events, tightening rules on a booming practice that’s drawing scrutiny across the world.
title: Brazil Moves to Ban Prediction Markets on Elections, Sports

description: A US Army soldier, Gannon Ken Van Dyke, was charged with using classified information to bet on if then-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro would be removed from office. Prosecutors say Van Dyke used Polymarket's prediction market and made more than $400,000. Van Dyke was part of the US team that eventually arrested Maduro in Venezuela. Matt Miller and Dani Burger discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Soldier Charged With Using Classified Data to Bet on Capture of Maduro

author: Anthony Capaccio
description: The Air Force and Navy proposed stepping up purchases of of Lockheed Martin Corp’s F-35 fighter jet over the next five years, a show of confidence for a plane that Elon Musk and other critics argue is becoming obsolete.
title: US Air Force, Navy Plan to Boost F-35 Fleet After Record Budget

author: Jonathan Gilbert
description: President Javier Milei’s marquee investment incentive package is set to bring forward development of a flagship oil field in Argentina’s booming Vaca Muerta shale patch.
title: Milei Incentives Set to Boost $12 Billion Vaca Muerta Oil Field

author: Daniel Flatley
description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent talked up the idea of extending currency swap lines to more countries as a way to strengthen “dollar dominance” in a social media post Friday as speculation continues over why rich countries such as the United Arab Emirates would be interested in the arrangement.
title: Bessent Casts Potential New Swap Lines as Boost to Dollar’s Role

description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth accused European and Asian countries of relying on the US military to reopen the vital Strait of Hormuz after it was closed by the war against Iran. "The time for freeriding is over,” he said Friday. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Hegseth Accuses Europe, Asia of ‘Freeriding’ Over Hormuz

author: Daniel Carvalho
description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent surgery to remove a fairly routine skin cancer lesion, a procedure doctors said would have no impact on the 80-year-old leader’s reelection campaign.
title: Lula Has Skin Cancer Lesion Removed Ahead of Reelection Bid

description: US Representative French Hill, chair of the House Financial Services Committee, discusses the recent decision by the Department of Justice to drop the criminal investigation into the Federal Reserve's building costs. Speaking on Bloomberg Television, Rep. Hill says the criminal probe was a distraction that could have delayed the appointment of a new Federal Reserve chair. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: DOJ Dropping Powell Probe Is Step in Right Direction, French Hill Says

description: President Donald Trump said he would investigate federal employees placing bets on event-betting platforms during comments with reports at the White House on April 23. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says He'll 'Look Into' Prediction Market Bets

author: Brian Platt, Christine Dobby
description: Facing economic strains and tensions with the US, the prime minister is relying on a tight-knit group of allies to make trade deals and streamline government.
title: Mark Carney's C-Suite Inner Circle Is Selling the World on Canada

author: Yazhou Sun, Amy Thomson
description: The value of the US government stake in Intel Corp. has increased fourfold to hit a value of about $36 billion after the chipmaker’s financial outlook showed a resurgence in sales.
title: US Government Stake in Intel Has Jumped 300% to $36 Billion

author: Rose Henderson
description: A bill to legalize assisted dying in England and Wales fell by the wayside on Friday when the bill ran out of time after becoming snarled in the upper chamber of Britain’s parliament.
title: UK’s Assisted Dying Bill Fails After Parliamentary Time Runs Out

description: Romanian President Nicușor Dan tells Bloomberg’s Oliver Crook that Bucharest backs the NATO transatlantic alliance, as he highlights US-Romanian economic ties with the country aiming to boost domestic natural gas production. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Romanian President on Europe-US Relations, Iran War Impact

author: Chris Strohm
description: The Justice Department is ending a controversial investigation into building-renovation cost overruns by the Federal Reserve, potentially clearing a path to confirmation for Kevin Warsh, President Donald Trump’s pick to be the next Fed leader.
title: DOJ Drops Probe Into Powell and Fed Building Costs

description: President Donald Trump said he won't be rushed to end the war in Iran and pushed back on questions that the conflict is exceeding the four-to-six week timeline that he and advisers previously set for the war. He spoke Thursday in the Oval Office.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says He Won't Be Rushed to End Iran War

author: Tyler Clifford
description: (Corrects Pirro’s title in the first sentence.)
title: DOJ Probe Into Powell and Fed Building Costs Has Been Dropped

author: Roxana Tiron
description: The Pentagon agency tasked with protecting classified information released to US federal contractors found more than 800 security violations and more than 1,000 open security vulnerabilities last fiscal year, according to the Government Accountability Office.
title: US Companies Had 815 Classified Data Violations, GAO Finds

author: Andrea Palasciano, Alberto Nardelli, Jorge Valero
description: The European Union is drawing up plans to help countries fight off a military assault with or without its superpower ally, the US.
title: EU Is Drafting Plans to Defend Its Borders as US Support Wavers

author: Oliver Crook, Irina Vilcu
description: Romania’s President Nicusor Dan said the “pragmatic” approach taken by a European coalition boosts the chances of Iran reopening the strait of Hormuz, as the Middle East crisis pushes energy prices up across the continent.
title: Romania President Defends Europe’s ‘Pragmatic’ Hormuz Stance

author: Anthony Halpin
description: Russia and Ukraine exchanged prisoners of war on Friday, swapping 193 from each side, the two countries said.
title: Russia and Ukraine Exchange 193 Prisoners Each in Latest Swap

description: President Donald Trump is making it easier to move oil, fuel and fertilizer around the US by extending a 90-day shipping waiver. Robert McNally, Rapidan Energy Group founder, says the move could help "on the margins." He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Limiting Oil Exports Would Be a Mistake, McNally Says

author: Dan Strumpf, Tooba Khan, Eltaf Najafizada
description: Iran’s foreign minister is expected to arrive in Pakistan, the main mediator between Tehran and Washington, though it was unclear if he’d meet American officials.
title: Iran Chief Diplomat to Visit Pakistan as Trump Talks Up Blockade

description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth criticized European and Asian countries for relying on the US military to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. He said at a Pentagon briefing Friday morning that the Navy blockade is growing and going global. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Hegseth Tells Europe the Time for Freeriding Is Over

author: Thomas Escritt
description: Hungary’s incoming Prime Minister Peter Magyar is planning to replace Viktor Orban’s all-male cabinet with a more diverse team of top officials as he looks to make a clean break with his country’s illiberal past.
title: Hungary’s Magyar Taps Blind Minister in Diverse Cabinet Drive

author: Andrea Palasciano, Donato Paolo Mancini
description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said she’s had no recent contact with President Donald Trump, though relations with the US were “still solid.”
title: Meloni Hasn’t Spoken to Trump, But Says US Ties Are ‘Solid’

author: Roxana Tiron, Anthony Capaccio
description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth criticized European and Asian countries for relying on the US military to reopen the vital Strait of Hormuz after it was closed by the war against Iran.
title: Hegseth Blasts Europe, Asia for ‘Freeriding’ on US Hormuz Action

author: Sudhi Ranjan Sen, Mihir Mishra
description: India is considering various options regarding its stake in the Chabahar port in Iran, including temporarily divesting from it, ahead of the expiry of a US sanctions waiver in coming days, officials familiar with the matter said.
title: India Mulls Options on Iran Port Stake Before Sanctions Kick In

author: Dan Strumpf, Tooba Khan
description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is expected to arrive in Pakistan’s capital on Friday night for a possible second round of peace talks with the US, according to officials in Islamabad familiar with the matter.
title: Iran Foreign Minister to Visit Islamabad Friday, Pakistan Says

author: Paul Wallace
description: Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he recently had successful treatment for cancer and is “in excellent physical condition.”
title: Netanyahu Reveals He Had Successful Prostate Cancer Treatment

author: Jonathan Tamari
description: China has gained from Trump’s stumbles
title: Trump’s Weaker Footing Ahead of China Trip, and His Nerd Prom Return

author: Lucy White
description: The UK has insisted it will retain sovereignty of the Falklands Islands, after a leaked Pentagon email suggested the US would review the territory’s position as punishment for Britain’s lack of support on the war in Iran.
title: UK Insists Sovereignty of Falklands Is Unchanged After US Threat

author: Jennifer A Dlouhy
description: President Donald Trump’s administration has given a 90-day extension to a shipping waiver making it easier to move oil, fuel and fertilizer around the US, marking the latest effort by the White House to counter supply disruptions tied to the Iran war.
title: White House Extends Shipping Waiver to August to Ease Oil Crunch

author: Jorge Valero
description: Tensions over the European Union’s next long-term budget surfaced in negotiations among member states, with the bloc’s richer members insisting that their contributions to the common budget be reduced.
title: Richer European Countries Question Multi-Trillion Budget Talks

author: Julian Lee, Anthony Di Paola
description: Iran is continuing to load millions of barrels of oil onto supertankers, an activity that will only become increasingly difficult if the US keeps up a blockade on Tehran’s shipping.
title: Iran Keeps Loading Oil Onto Tankers Even as US Blocks Exit Route

author: Oscar Medina
description: Colombia’s government is pressing ahead with a plan to transfer about $7 billion from private pension savings into the public retirement system, a move that risks destabilizing local markets as funds may be forced to rapidly liquidate assets to comply.
title: Petro Speeds $7 Billion Pension Transfers, Risking Market Shock

author: Gonzalo Soto
description: The president has had a run of recent setbacks,  with security lapses chief among them.
title: Sheinbaum Can’t Escape Mexico’s Security Dilemma

author: Alberto Nardelli, Jorge Valero
description: European Council President Antonio Costa warned EU leaders that the bloc will be lost if it outsources key decisions to US President Donald Trump.
title: EU Chief Warns Leaders Bloc Will Lose Its Way by Following Trump

description: President Donald Trump said he is considering having the US purchase Spirit Aviation Holdings Inc., saying it could be a potentially good investment for the federal government. "We’d be getting it virtually debt free. They have some good aircraft and good assets," the president told reporters Thursday. Bloomberg's Benedikt Kammel reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says He's Considering US Purchase of Spirit Airlines

author: Charlie Duxbury, Sanne Wass, Julian Lee
description: Oil tankers transporting Russian crude through the Baltic Sea have been steering clear of Swedish waters after the Nordic nation began boarding vessels at sea to check their papers.
title: Russia-Linked Vessels Avoiding Swedish Waters After Boardings

author: Dana Khraiche, Paul Wallace, Eltaf Najafizada
description: The US increased pressure on Iran with its naval blockade, as it seeks to get Tehran to agree to talks, while Israel and Lebanon are set to extend a ceasefire for three weeks.
title: Trump Talks Up Iran Blockade as Israel-Lebanon Truce Extended

author: Ram Anand, Faris Mokhtar, Netty Idayu Ismail
description: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim is considering calling for a general election in the third quarter as his government weighs politically sensitive cuts to fuel subsidies amid the global energy crunch, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
title: Malaysia’s Anwar Eyes Polls by October as Fuel Subsidy Cut Looms

author: Cale Brooks, Joe Weisenthal, Tracy Alloway
description: From Delcy to Milei.
title: James Bosworth on the ‘Orange Wave’ Happening Across Latin America

description: Yuri, a US-sanctioned supertanker carrying 2 million barrels of Iranian crude loaded from Kharg Island, appeared to be attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz on Friday. Traffic through the waterway is otherwise at a virtual standstill. Bloomberg's Weilun Soon reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Sanctioned Tanker Carrying Iranian Oil Attempts to Cross Hormuz

author: Andrea Palasciano, Michael Nienaber
description: President Emmanuel Macron said France and Germany will press ahead with a next-generation fighter-jet project despite persistent divisions after speaking on the sidelines of a summit with Chancellor Friedrich Merz.
title: Macron Says Fighter-Jet Project Not Dead After Talk With Merz

author: Elena Mazneva, Stephen Stapczynski
description: Europe is beginning the roll-out of a ban on imports of Russian liquefied natural gas at a difficult time, with the war in Iran seriously disrupting global supply.
title: EU Starts Roll-Out of Russian LNG Import Ban at a Difficult Time

author: Jorge Valero, Daniel Basteiro, Max Ramsay
description: European Union leaders tasked the bloc’s finance ministers to come up with new measures to deal with the continent’s energy crunch after assessing that current proposals don’t go far enough, according to a person familiar with the conversations.
title: EU Leaders Seek New Energy Proposals After Measures Fall Short

author: Daniel Basteiro
description: Spain’s prime minister said his government will be maintaining normal cooperation with NATO allies and brushed off a report that US officials are considering punishing his country for its stance on the Iran war.
title: Sanchez Pledges Cooperation After Report of US Threat Over NATO

author: Unni Krishnan
description: India has criticized an article shared by US President Donald Trump on social media that termed the South Asian nation a “hellhole,” straining ties that were improving after a year of tensions over tariffs and geopolitical differences.
title: India Condemns Trump Social Media Post Calling Nation ‘Hellhole’

author: Lili Pike
description: China will begin a major campaign aimed at accelerating climate action by local authorities, warning regional officials that they will be held accountable for failing to make progress toward President Xi Jinping’s green targets.
title: Fail on Climate Action and Miss Out on Promotion, China Warns Officials

description: India’s state election in West Bengal has emerged as a critical political test for Modi’s BJP as well as opposition parties. The outcome matters especially as the BJP seeks to expand beyond its northern strongholds, while regional parties face a high‑stakes fight for political survival. Political analyst and commentator Arati Jerath joined Haslinda Amin and Menaka Doshi on Insight with Haslinda Amin to assess what is at stake and how the vote could shape India’s political landscape. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Is West Bengal a Bigger Test for Modi's BJP or the Opposition?

description: European Union leaders signaled that preliminary conditions are in place for Ukraine to begin the first stage of the membership process, a boost for Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy’s efforts to join the bloc. At a summit in Cyprus Thursday, leaders agreed the first accession negotiations could start in the coming weeks and months, according to an EU official, who spoke on the condition of anonymity. Bloomberg's Oliver Crook reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Ukraine's EU Membership Ambitions Boosted

author: Patpicha Tanakasempipat
description: Thailand’s Supreme Court accepted a case accusing a group of opposition lawmakers of violating ethical standards over their failed bid to amend the country’s royal insult law, underscoring the continued challenges facing progressive politicians.
title: Thai Court Accepts Case Against Opposition Lawmakers Over Royal Insult Law

author: Kari Lundgren
description: Norway plans to restrict access to social media for children under 16, joining a growing number of countries responding to concerns about the potential harm kids face online.
title: Norway Set to Become Latest Country to Ban Social Media for Under 16s

description: President Donald Trump said Israel and Lebanon will extend their ceasefire by three weeks, a move that creates space to work on a long-term deal and removes a roadblock to ending the US war with Iran. Bloomberg's Dana Khraiche reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Israel, Lebanon Set to Work on Long-Term Truce

description: Eight weeks on from the start of the US-Israel war with Iran, Wendy Sherman, architect of the 2015 nuclear deal, looks beyond the Middle East to how China and Russia are beneficiaries of the current conflict. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: How to Get a Deal With Iran

author: Marton Kasnyik, Andrea Dudik, Zoltan Simon
description: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban’s abrupt expulsion is now shining a spotlight on the biggest financial beneficiaries of his regime, raising questions about who’ll remain in the country with their wealth intact.
title: Wealthy Orban Acolytes Weigh Future With Riches Under Threat

author: Lucille Liu
description: Beijing is apparently sending two pandas to the US, adding to signs of stabilizing ties between the nations just before President Donald Trump’s planned meeting with Xi Jinping in mid-May.
title: China Poised to Send Pandas to US Before Trump’s Planned Visit

author: Yuliya Fedorinova, Edward Clark, Ilya Arkhipov, Nariman Gizitdinov
description: Central Asia, once treated as a geopolitical backwater, is seizing the spotlight as international capital flows and foreign powers compete for access to its vast mineral and energy wealth.
title: Central Asia Gains as War Shakes Energy Markets and Trade Routes

author: Weilun Soon
description: A US-sanctioned supertanker laden with Iranian oil appeared to be attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz on Friday, with traffic through the waterway otherwise at a virtual standstill.
title: US-Sanctioned Supertanker With Iranian Oil Tries Hormuz Transit

author: Philip Heijmans, Chandra Asmara
description: Indonesia’s top diplomat said the country will not pursue tolls on ships passing through the Strait of Malacca, seeking to calm concerns after its finance minister raised the idea this week.
title: Indonesia Rules Out Levies for Malacca Strait Ship Transits

description: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Senator Bill Hagerty (R-TN) says President Trump "has all the cards" in Iran negotiations and warns Tehran's oil storage constraints could become a near-term breaking point. Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi (D-IL) calls the conflict with Iran a "colossal disaster," warning Tehran now has a "chokehold" on global energy via the Strait of Hormuz. John Bolton, former US National Security Advisor and former US Ambassador to the United Nations, argues the US should take the time necessary to overthrow the regime in Iran.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump: We Have 'Total Control' of the Strait of Hormuz | Balance of Power: Late Edition 04/23/2026
